methodology: The same frozen, trained classifier flood_national_priority.json's avg_predicted_risk uses, scored day-by-day for the next 7 real forecast days from Open-Meteo's published forecast (not the 90-day historical average the nowcast uses). 13 prior days of near-real-time rainfall are fetched only to correctly seed the rolling-rain features for day 1 of the forecast, and are not themselves scored or reported. This inherits the weather forecast's own uncertainty, which grows with each day further out — treat later days as directional, not precise.
